name: Cathedral Wall Window Bay
knownLimits: This is the first asset-level wall-window bay candidate, not final stained glass.
The glass uses procedural colored lancet meshes rather than generated/painted stained-glass texture panels.
Floor-light material is deliberately subdued so it reads as cast light rather than stray geometry.
The Temple room material-batches repeated bay meshes during export; future room work should preserve that batching or replace it with instancing.
